purpose: Prevent Item and SKU activation failures from hiding actionable validation messages in ITEM_NOT_ACTIVATABLE responses.
data: Existing local Vue test mounts with one synthetic Item and SKU per case. In-memory mocked 422 and fallback error responses. No database, new fixtures, or network service.
concurrency: Three ordinary client test cases using existing Vitest worker and job settings.
repetitions: Once per normal functional client test run. No scheduled or repeated execution added.
thresholds: Assert verbatim messages in response order, including same-field messages, error state reset on retry, and SKU dialog dismissal. Existing coverage floors and test assertions are unchanged.
trigger: Routine functional client test discovery. Private Playwright verification stays outside CI. No workflow or capacity catalog changes.
cost: Estimated under one second for the three cases. No new CI job. CI wall-clock impact has not been measured.
